entries.rationale: buildSystemPrompt is defined exactly once (export const) in src/agent/prompt.ts; other matches are call sites.

entries.query: function that runs the agent loop until finish

CompactionBreaker class is defined in src/agent/compaction-breaker.ts. Splitting `compactionBreaker` into `compaction` + `breaker` should hit it; the current tokenizer only matches whole-token `compaction`/`breaker`.
Underscored snake_case query — the tool's canonical name (line 183) and exported parser (line 136).

entries.query: main entrypoint cli what does this do
entries.rationale: src/apps/cli/index.ts is the CLI entrypoint (`const main = async ...`). Noisy stop-words validate BM25/IDF: rare tokens (`entrypoint`, `cli`) should outweigh the common ones.
FrameTier penalty target: with node_modules present, naive ripgrep ranks countless `main.js`/`index.js` matches inside dependencies. The expected owners are our `src/` index modules.

entries.query: REPL loop where each user line continues conversation

Test-file query should still surface tests/unit/memory.test.ts and tests/unit/memory-adapters.test.ts (the sqlite-backed memory store coverage).
Streaming event dispatch is split across streaming-dispatch.ts (streamingTurn) and dispatch.ts (dispatchTool); a good localizer surfaces both.
resolveJailed is defined in src/storage/service.ts (line 135) and re-exported via @/storage; the definition file is the owner.

entries.query: send a chat completion request to OpenAI with tools
entries.rationale: src/llm/adapters/openai.ts is the OpenAI Chat Completions adapter (vision content parts, tool_choice mapping, etc.).
src/memory/adapters/sqlite.ts is the bun:sqlite-backed PersistentStorePort implementation.
The localize tool is itself the most ripgrep-heavy tool; self-localization is a useful sanity floor.
